items.issue: The autocodex host adapter review_gap check refuses a converged->done transition after a tail sweep ("implementation changed since the converged review"), which contradicts phase-review.md Tail sweep step 4 (finalize without reopening review). It paused batch 202610242338 on PRD 00089 under site host_tail_sweep_provenance. Needs a fix in the autocodex adapter, not in this plugin.

A `.git` at the store root is never treated as a unit, because the `base == store` branch runs first. The walk then enters `store/.git`, yields its `hooks/*` files, and hits the same `.git/hooks` mkdir denial. `prune_empty_dirs` also removes empty dirs inside it. This is unlikely, but it is the same crash class
items.reason: Repository at the tmp store root is outside nested-fixture scope; moving the store into its own trash is invalid. Separate refusal policy required.
